11.1 Responsive Design – Overview

The ABpE Portal follows the mobile-first approach and is optimized for all device classes – from smartphones to tablets to desktops. The layout dynamically adapts to the screen size.

11.2 Breakpoints

Three main breakpoints are used:

  • Mobile (default, <768px): Sidebar as bottom navigation, full width
  • Tablet (≥768px): Sidebar as side bar (280px), main content with margin
  • Desktop (≥1200px): Sidebar expanded (300px)
/* Mobile First (default) */
.sidebar { width: 100%; position: fixed; bottom: 0; height: auto; }
.main-content { margin-left: 0; padding: 1rem; }
.desktop-only { display: none; }

/* Tablet (≥768px) */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
    .sidebar { width: 280px; height: 100vh; position: fixed; top: 0; }
    .main-content { margin-left: 280px; padding: 1.5rem; }
    .mobile-only { display: none; }
    .desktop-only { display: block; }
}

/* Desktop (≥1200px) */
@media (min-width: 1200px) {
    .sidebar { width: 300px; }
    .main-content { margin-left: 300px; padding: 2rem; }
}

11.3 Mobile Navigation

On mobile devices, a bottom navigation is displayed, providing quick access to the most important functions:

<div class="mobile-bottom-nav mobile-only">
    <a href="{% url 'dashboard' %}" class="mobile-nav-item">
        <i class="bi bi-speedometer2"></i>
        <span>Dashboard</span>
    </a>
    <a href="{% url 'cv_editor' %}" class="mobile-nav-item">
        <i class="bi bi-file-earmark-text"></i>
        <span>CV</span>
    </a>
    <a href="#" onclick="toggleSidebar()" class="mobile-nav-item">
        <i class="bi bi-list"></i>
        <span>Menu</span>
    </a>
</div>

11.4 Sidebar Toggle for Mobile

On mobile devices, the sidebar is hidden by default and can be shown via a button (hamburger menu).

/* Sidebar toggle for mobile */
.sidebar.collapsed {
    transform: translateX(-100%);
}

.sidebar-toggle {
    display: block;
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 1rem;
    right: 1rem;
    z-index: 1000;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
    .sidebar-toggle {
        display: none;
    }
}

11.5 Touch Optimization

Interactive elements are optimized for touch operation:

  • Buttons and links have a minimum size of 44x44px
  • Sufficient spacing between clickable elements
  • Hover effects are disabled on touch devices or replaced by active states
  • Scrollable areas have enough padding for thumbs

11.6 Responsive Tables and Grids

Tables and grids adapt to smaller screens:

@media (max-width: 992px) {
    .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .system-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    .action-buttons { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .system-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .action-buttons { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    
    /* Tables horizontally scrollable */
    .table-container {
        overflow-x: auto;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    }
}

11.7 Responsive Typography

Font sizes adapt to different screen sizes:

html { font-size: 16px; }

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    html { font-size: 14px; }
    h1 { font-size: 1.8rem; }
    h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; }
}

@media (min-width: 1200px) {
    html { font-size: 18px; }
}
